body:
## Objective
Review the full diff from a 5-builder critique fix session. Verify correctness, no regressions, no missed issues, no conflicts between parallel builders.

## Context
5 builders fixed UX critique issues in parallel on non-overlapping files. All reported typecheck + build clean individually. Need independent audit of the combined result.

## What changed (by builder)

**Builder 1 — global.css:**
- Removed Inter from --font-sans (now system-ui stack)
- Added focus-visible styles (outline 2px accent)
- Added prefers-reduced-motion media query
- Deleted .text-gradient, .grid-bg, .noise-bg classes

**Builder 2 — index.astro, HeroScene.tsx, ScrollIndicator.tsx, Layout.astro:**
- Removed HeroTitle component, replaced with static h1 + CSS keyframe letter animation
- Subtitle: "Code • Music • Guyana" → "Code • Guyana"
- Added noscript in HeroScene container
- Added contact CTA section (email, GitHub, LinkedIn) between BlogList and Footer
- HeroScene: reduced-motion guard (return null)
- ScrollIndicator: reduced-motion guard (static version)
- Layout.astro: removed Inter from Google Fonts link

**Builder 3 — AboutCard.tsx, site.ts:**
- Removed all music refs (stats, bio, site.ts titles/bios/jobTitle/alternateNames/sameAs)
- LUUTECH → LUGETECH
- Removed scan lines + decorative rings
- Image: width/height/loading=lazy/onError
- text-gradient → text-accent
- Removed grid-bg usage
- Reduced-motion guard for tilt

**Builder 4 — ProjectGrid.tsx, ProjectCard.tsx:**
- Fixed typos: "checkout"→"Check out", "Github"→"GitHub"
- Removed 3D tilt from ProjectCard (mouse-only accessibility issue)
- CSS hover border instead of motion border glow
- Image: loading=lazy/width/height/onError
- Reduced-motion guard for entrance animation

**Builder 5 — BlogCard.tsx, Footer.tsx:**
- Fixed nested anchors (stretched-link pattern)
- Removed YouTube link from footer
- Removed "Music producer" from footer tagline
- Added flex-wrap to footer links
- Fixed text-muted/50 → text-muted (contrast)

## Review Tasks

1. **Run typecheck + build:**
   ```bash
   cd /Users/kentaylor/developer/kentaylor.site && npx tsc --noEmit && npx astro build
   ```
   Report any errors.

2. **Check for orphaned references.** Builder 1 deleted .text-gradient, .grid-bg, .noise-bg CSS classes. Other builders were told to remove usage, but verify:
   ```bash
   cd /Users/kentaylor/developer/kentaylor.site && rg -n "text-gradient|grid-bg|noise-bg" src/ --type tsx --type astro --type css
   ```
   Any remaining usage = broken (class defined nowhere). Report findings.

3. **Check for orphaned imports.** Builder 2 removed HeroTitle usage from index.astro. Verify HeroTitle.tsx isn't imported anywhere else. Also check if any file still imports HeroTitle. Also verify no unused imports remain in files builders edited (e.g., ProjectCard removed framer-motion hooks — are motion/useMotionValue still imported but unused?).

4. **Verify zero music references remain.** Run:
   ```bash
   cd /Users/kentaylor/developer/kentaylor.site && rg -i "music|producer|beatmaker|youtube|kenda" src/ --type tsx --type astro --type ts
   ```
   Report any matches. Expected: zero (except maybe in blog MDX content which is NOT in scope — only check .tsx/.astro/.ts files).

5. **Check the static h1 in index.astro.** Verify:
   - h1 exists as static HTML (not client:load)
   - CSS keyframe animation is valid
   - No duplicate h1 (HeroTitle removed entirely, not just unused)
   - noscript block present

6. **Check the CTA section.** Verify it's between BlogList and Footer, has email + GitHub + LinkedIn, proper styling.

7. **Check BlogCard stretched-link pattern.** Verify:
   - Outer element is div/article (not a)
   - Stretched link has after:absolute after:inset-0 z-10
   - Tag links have relative z-20
   - No nested anchors

8. **Check for conflicts.** Since 5 builders worked in parallel, verify no file was accidentally touched by two builders. Check git diff stat:
   ```bash
   cd /Users/kentaylor/developer/kentaylor.site && git diff --stat
   ```

9. **Spot-check reduced-motion guards.** Verify AboutCard, ProjectCard, HeroScene, ScrollIndicator all have the matchMedia check and conditionally skip animations.

10. **Check focus-visible CSS.** Verify the global focus-visible style covers all interactive elements and doesn't conflict with existing focus styles (e.g., ShareButtons focus-visible:ring).

## Deliverables
- Pass/fail for each check
- Any errors found with file:line
- Any orphaned references or broken imports
- Overall verdict: ship-ready or needs fixes
- If fixes needed, specify exactly what + which file
